== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|An Overlady represents a specific level of power and spiritual [[advancement]], often associated with the concept of an Overlord. This stage is characterized by a profound revelation that allows an individual to recognize and refocus their identity rather than serving as their most defining characteristic. Those who reach this level possess immense [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] and enhanced capabilities, such as hearing that extends beyond the senses of lower-ranked individuals like [[Jades]]. The power of an Overlady can be channeled into techniques, such as focusing spiritual force through a bow to create high-intensity projectiles. While an Overlady is significantly more powerful than an [[Underlord]] or [[Lowgold]], they are still considered vastly inferior to a [[Dreadgod]]. Advancing to this stage can involve risks; if an individual attempts to progress under extreme spiritual stress, they may fail to fully advance and instead become a [[pseudo-Herald]]. Some Overladies are identified as [[dragons]], while others may belong to specific groups like [[Redmoon Hall]].}}
